data.description:
Each target suffers @DATA[key.status]. Each target also loses Resistance to @DATA[key.typeLocal] damage (if they have it) until the start of your next turn, and cannot gain Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.

Target Suffers: @EFFECT[@DATA[key.status]]
Target Gains: @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-air], @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-bolt], @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-dark], @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-earth], @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-fire], @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-ice], @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-light], or @EFFECT[pfu-haunting-tone-physical]
